title: Encore By Mingara Designed By Marchese Partners
bodyHtml:
Project Spotlight: A Boutique Coastal Retreat by Marchese Partners

Nestled on the picturesque Central Coast of NSW, Encore by Mingara is a boutique hotel that seamlessly blends contemporary elegance with the relaxed charm of coastal living.

Designed by the acclaimed Marchese Partners, this thoughtfully curated development offers 86 beautifully appointed rooms, each crafted to reflect the region’s lifestyle, breathtaking beaches, and vibrant local experiences.

From the moment guests step inside, they are immersed in an environment that captures the essence of the Central Coast. Marchese Partners have masterfully woven eclectic coastal hues and textures throughout the interiors, creating a sophisticated yet inviting retreat.

The result is a design that not only pays homage to its surroundings but also elevates the guest experience through a fusion of aesthetics and functionality.

Studio Bagno in the Encore Bathrooms

At the heart of Encore’s elegant bathrooms lies a selection of premium Studio Bagno bathware, meticulously chosen to complement the hotel’s refined aesthetic. A standout feature is the Shard X Plan vanity tops, mounted on custom-designed vanities that enhance both form and function. Thoughtfully integrated compartments and in-built towel rails ensure maximum usability while maintaining a sleek, uncluttered look.

Our sleek Manhattan Rimless Wall Faced Pan with Oli Concealed cistern provides powerful yet efficient flush performance, with added sustainability benefits thank to our Cisterns being the only in-wall cistern on the Australian market with a unique delayed refill, saving half a litre of water every flush vs other cisterns on the market.

With an emphasis on quality, innovation, and timeless design, Studio Bagno’s bathware contributes to the luxurious and harmonious atmosphere that defines Encore by Mingara. The result is a sanctuary where guests can unwind in style, surrounded by premium finishes and intelligent design solutions.

A Testament to Inspired Design

Encore by Mingara is a shining example of how architecture and interiors can work in perfect harmony to create an exceptional hospitality experience. Through innovative design choices and meticulous attention to detail, Marchese Partners have delivered a destination that is as inspiring as its surroundings.

Studio Bagno is proud to have played a role in this remarkable project, continuing our commitment to delivering bathware solutions that complement Australia’s most sophisticated developments.
